items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: I don't think I ever met anyone who could surpass Sal.

ctx.x: And as far as sheer excitement and sheer joy of playing, I don't think I ever met anyone who could surpass Sal. Unfortunately, and once again, I'm only bringing up these points because I feel they had something to do with his true -- lack of true success, and I feel that one of his hindrances was the fact that he was one of those kind of great soloists who maybe should have studied a little bit. And I'm not certainly talking about lack of knowledge of music itself, but there's a -- with the playing of any…
